name: TaiDoc Technology Corporation
summary: TaiDoc Technology Corporation manufactures and markets medical devices in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers In vitro diagnostics products, including multiple parameter monitoring systems, point of care testing devices, and lancet and lancing devices; vet health care products comprise blood glucose and calcium meters, and blood ketone meters; and medical devices, such as nebulizers, thermometers, blood pressure monitors, vital sign monitors, and pulse oximeters. It also provides telehealth remote monitoring devices and smartphone applications; and Covid-19 antigen rapid test kits.
